title: kit.agent-identities.v1
description: agent-identities.json: the mapping table of agent principals (docs/AGENT-GUARD.md). Every agent ROLE (the main session, a subagent type, a ralph loop, Codex, a CI bot, a GitHub App) has a kit principal id kit:agent:<trust-domain>:<kind>:<local>, its OWN Ed25519 key (public half here, private half in the 0700 key store of the machine that runs it: never shared between ids) and, where the owner created one, a GitHub App identity. The table is the base of every signature check; CI reads it from the BASE branch, so a pull request cannot add its own key. Changes need the owner's signed approval.

owners.description: The owner principals whose Ed25519 keys sign approvals (guard-path changes, merge reviews recorded outside GitHub).

publicKey.description: Base64 SPKI DER of an Ed25519 public key.

id.description: Agent entity id, class agent; urn shape kit:<class>:<trust-domain>:<subclass>:<local-part>.

expiresAt.description: At most 90 days after issuedAt (keys rotate).

bot.description: The bot login commits and merges carry (<slug>[bot]).

evidence.description: Sequence number of the issuance evidence record.
